microtheory.name: energy_systems
microtheory.definition: Energy systems — generation, transmission, distribution, storage, use. Fossil (coal, oil, gas), nuclear, renewables (solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, biomass), efficiency, grid + microgrid, decarbonisation. Substrate analogue: discipline of organising flows of energy through technical + economic systems.

concepts.name: energy_resource
concepts.definition: Source from which energy is extracted. Renewable (sustained) vs non-renewable (depleted by use).

concepts.name: primary_energy
concepts.definition: Energy in natural form before conversion. Solar, wind, fossil fuel chemical, nuclear binding, geothermal heat.

concepts.name: secondary_energy
concepts.definition: Energy after conversion. Electricity, refined fuels, hydrogen.

concepts.name: end_use_energy
concepts.definition: Energy delivered to final consumption. Heat, light, motion, electronics.

concepts.name: energy_efficiency
concepts.definition: Useful output / energy input. Ranges from ~30% (thermal power plants) to >95% (LEDs).

concepts.name: fossil_fuel
concepts.definition: Hydrocarbons formed from ancient biomass. Coal + oil + natural gas. Carbon-emissions source.

concepts.name: coal
concepts.definition: Solid carbonaceous rock. Lignite → bituminous → anthracite ranks. Highest CO2 per unit energy. Powered industrial revolution.

concepts.name: petroleum
concepts.definition: Liquid hydrocarbons. Crude oil refined to gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, plastics feedstock. Dominant transport energy.

concepts.name: natural_gas
concepts.definition: Methane primarily. Cleanest fossil fuel per BTU. Power + heating + petrochemical. LNG enables global trade.

concepts.name: shale_revolution
concepts.definition: Hydraulic fracturing + horizontal drilling. Unlocked unconventional oil + gas ~2008. Reshaped US energy.

concepts.name: nuclear_fission_power
concepts.definition: Splitting heavy nuclei (U-235, Pu-239). Releases binding energy. Light water reactors dominant. Carbon-free; waste + accident concerns.

concepts.name: nuclear_reactor_types
concepts.definition: Pressurised water (PWR), boiling water (BWR), CANDU (heavy water), small modular (SMR), Gen IV designs.

concepts.name: nuclear_fuel_cycle
concepts.definition: Mining → enrichment → fabrication → reactor → spent fuel → reprocessing/disposal.

concepts.name: nuclear_waste
concepts.definition: Spent fuel + activated materials. High-level waste radioactive for ~10,000+ years. Geological disposal proposed (Yucca, Onkalo).

concepts.name: nuclear_fusion
concepts.definition: Light nuclei combine (H → He). Source of star energy. ITER + commercial efforts (CFS, Helion, TAE). Achieved net energy NIF Dec 2022.

concepts.name: solar_photovoltaic
concepts.definition: PV. Semiconductor converts light to electricity. Silicon dominant. Costs declined ~90% 2010-2020.

concepts.name: solar_thermal
concepts.definition: Concentrated solar power (CSP). Mirrors focus sunlight, heat working fluid, drive turbine. Can include storage.

concepts.name: wind_power
concepts.definition: Wind turns turbine generators. Onshore + offshore. Cost declined dramatically. Variability + transmission challenges.

concepts.name: hydropower
concepts.definition: Water flow drives turbines. Dam + reservoir + run-of-river + pumped storage. Largest current renewable.

concepts.name: geothermal_energy
concepts.definition: Heat from earth's interior. Power + direct use. High in geologically active areas (Iceland).

concepts.name: biomass_bioenergy
concepts.definition: Plant-derived. Burned directly + converted to liquid fuels (ethanol, biodiesel). Carbon-neutral if regrowth equals harvest.

concepts.name: electric_grid
concepts.definition: Network connecting generators + transmission + distribution + consumers. AC dominant. Frequency regulation critical.

concepts.name: transmission_high_voltage
concepts.definition: Long-distance bulk power. HVAC + HVDC. Higher voltage reduces I²R losses. UHV grids in China.

concepts.name: distribution_network
concepts.definition: Local lower-voltage delivery to consumers. Last mile of grid. Substrate analogue: substrate's leaf-level distribution.

concepts.name: load_following
concepts.definition: Generation matches demand instant by instant. Dispatchable plants required. Renewables variable.

concepts.name: frequency_regulation
concepts.definition: Maintain 50 or 60 Hz precisely. Generator inertia + ancillary services. Renewables reduce inertia.

concepts.name: smart_grid
concepts.definition: Bidirectional communication + sensors + control. Demand response, distributed resources, electric vehicles integrated.

concepts.name: microgrid
concepts.definition: Local energy system that can island from main grid. Resilience + integration of distributed renewables.

concepts.name: energy_storage
concepts.definition: Buffer between generation + consumption. Critical for variable renewables. Multiple technologies.

concepts.name: battery_grid_storage
concepts.definition: Electrochemical. Lithium-ion dominant. Costs falling. 4-hour duration economic; longer harder.

concepts.name: pumped_hydro_storage
concepts.definition: Pump water uphill when surplus; release through turbines when needed. Largest current storage capacity. Geographically constrained.

concepts.name: hydrogen_energy_carrier
concepts.definition: H2 produced (electrolysis from renewables = green; from gas = grey) + used (fuel cells, combustion, feedstock).

concepts.name: decarbonisation
concepts.definition: Reducing carbon intensity of energy system. Renewables + electrification + efficiency + carbon capture.

concepts.name: energy_transition
concepts.definition: Shift from fossil to low-carbon system. Multi-decade. Some sectors harder (aviation, cement, steel).

concepts.name: carbon_pricing
concepts.definition: Carbon tax or cap-and-trade. Internalises emissions externality. EU ETS most mature.

concepts.name: electrification
concepts.definition: Replace fossil end-uses with electricity (EVs, heat pumps). Multiplies grid demand + decarbonisation lever.

concepts.name: energy_density
concepts.definition: Energy per mass or volume. Fossil fuels exceptionally dense; batteries lagging. Determines what mobile applications feasible.

rules.name: energy_efficiency_first
rules.head: Jabberwock plans energy use
rules.body: reducing demand is typically cheaper + cleaner than adding supply. Negawatts. End-use efficiency is the low-hanging fruit.

rules.name: variability_demands_storage_or_flexibility
rules.head: Jabberwock integrates high renewable penetration
rules.body: solar + wind variable. Storage + demand response + transmission + curtailment + dispatchable backup all required. No single solution scales alone.

rules.name: decarbonisation_requires_sectoral_strategies
rules.head: Jabberwock targets net-zero
rules.body: different sectors face different barriers. Power easiest (electrify, renewables). Transport, buildings, industry, agriculture each need specific technologies + policies.

rules.name: grid_must_balance_continuously
rules.head: Jabberwock manages electricity system
rules.body: supply must equal demand instant by instant. Frequency deviates if not. Generators + storage + load adjust continuously.

rules.name: energy_density_constrains_mobile_applications
rules.head: Jabberwock considers electrification of transport
rules.body: aviation + long-haul shipping limited by current battery energy density. Hydrogen + sustainable liquid fuels may fill. Local + short-haul electrify readily.
